jobs.description: Mat4Green Tech AB (M4GT) is a Chalmers University spin-out based in Gothenburg. We develop and commercialise closed-loop processes for recovering and refining metals from industrial materials, with our own lab and pilot facilities in Gothenburg. We are now looking for a chemist who will take hands-on ownership of our recycling and purification work.About the roleYou will run and develop hydrometallurgical and electrochemical processes in our lab and pilot facility, from leaching and solvent extraction to electrolysis and final purification. You plan, build and manage your own projects: you define what equipment and materials are needed, find and negotiate with suppliers, carry purchases through, and keep the work documented and safe. You work closely with our technical team and take the process forward step by step towards industrial scale.What we are looking for    A Master's degree or higher in chemistry, chemical engineering or a related field    - A solid understanding of process chemistry, including solvent extraction and electrolysis, and of safe handling of the chemicals involved    - Experience in planning, writing up and managing technical projects    - A structured and efficient way of working, with the ability to adapt when conditions change    - The ability to find, negotiate and purchase the equipment and materials needed to carry out the job    - Fluent English; Swedish is a meritWhat we offerA key role in a technically strong team with close ties to Chalmers, a high degree of ownership, and the opportunity to take a process from the lab to industrial scale.ApplicationSend your CV and a short cover letter by e-mail. Interviews are held on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as possible.

Are you ready to lead a world-class Tissue Field Service organization?We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Manager, Tissue Field Service to lead our Tissue Field Services organization.In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for managing a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians supporting our Tissue customers mainly throughout EMEA region but also worldwide. You will have direct responsibility for field personnel based in Karlstad (Sweden) as well as other strategic Tissue Service locations across the EMEA region.You will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery while driving operational excellence, employee development, customer satisfaction, and business growth. Working closely with Sales, Project Management, Performance Centers, Product Management, and regional Operations teams, you will play a critical role in strengthening Valmet’s position as the preferred service partner for Tissue producers.Primary Location: Karlstad (Sweden) or another major Valmet location in EMEA.Your responsibilitiesIn your daily work, you will:    Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians located in Karlstad and other key EMEA service hubs.    Drive a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with Valmet's safety standards, policies, and customer site requirements.    Manage resource planning, workforce allocation, and competence development to ensure efficient execution of field service activities.    Ensure successful delivery of maintenance services, shutdowns, audits, inspections, troubleshooting assignments, machine upgrades, commissioning activities, and technical improvement projects.    Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and career development of field service personnel.    Define and monitor team performance through operational KPIs, utilization, customer satisfaction, profitability, safety, and employee engagement metrics.    Collaborate with Sales organizations to identify service opportunities, support customer development activities, and contribute to business growth targets.    Support quotation activities by providing technical expertise, resource estimations, and execution strategies for service projects.    Ensure effective coordination between Field Services, Project Teams, Performance Centers, Engineering, and Product Organizations.    Drive standardization and continuous improvement of service processes, methods, tools, and best practices.    Act as an escalation point for critical customer issues and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.    Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and customer focus throughout the organization.    Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives related to service growth, digitalization, remote services, and operational excellence.Expectations for youWe expect you to bring:    A degree in Engineering or equivalent technical experience.    Several years of experience in industrial field services, maintenance, tissue production, project management, or related service operations.    Proven experience in people leadership, team development, and performance management.    Good knowledge of Tissue production technologies, maintenance practices, and customer operations.    Experience managing multicultural teams and working within an international business environment.    Strong business acumen and understanding of service profitability, resource management, and customer value creation.    Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.    Ability to prioritize activities and make decisions in dynamic and fast-paced environments.    Experience with ERP, resource planning, and service management systems.    Fluency in English; additional languages are considered an asset.    Limited travel within the EMEA region could be needed, primarily team leadership and key operational activities.To succeed in this roleTo succeed in this position, you are a people-oriented leader who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent leadership and business management capabilities.You know how to motivate teams, develop talent, and create an environment where safety, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus are embedded in everyday work. You are comfortable balancing operational priorities with long-term strategic objectives and can effectively lead teams operating across multiple countries and cultures.You excel at building strong relationships with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders while maintaining a clear focus on execution, continuous improvement, and business results. Your leadership creates trust and engagement, enabling teams to consistently deliver exceptional service experiences and operational excellence.We also expect you to align with Valmet's Leadership Principles:    Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through.    Lead with courage – Champion change, challenge the status quo, and learn quickly.    Build on trust – Listen to understand, communicate openly, and create psychological safety.    Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, leverage diversity, and focus on customer success.Additional informationDid we catch your interest? If you need any more information, please contact: Raffaele Malutta, Tissue Machines Field Services Senior Manager: raffaele.malutta@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.For positions with people leadership responsibilities in Sweden, delegated Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) responsibilities form an integral part of the role. Relevant information will be shared and discussed during the recruitment process.When everything works togetherValmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. Join the team – and lead the way with us!www.valmet.com/careers

Are you someone who genuinely loves taking care of others? Do you believe skincare is more than just a routine, that it is a way of reconnecting, recharging, and making someone's day better? Then you might be the person we're looking for.NAP is a growing skincare and wellness space, grounded in presence, simplicity, and care. We work from our own New Aesthetic Philosophy. We don't follow fixed routines, we follow clinical thinking, and our therapists adjust every treatment as it happens. No two are quite the same.That also means the work here is broader than facials. People come to us for skin treatments and peels, for facial and full-body massage, for wellness and stress relief, and for lashes and brows. Some come before a wedding, some while they are pregnant, and some simply to sleep for 80 minutes. We're now ready to welcome a new team member who shares our philosophy and values.What you’ll be doing:    Performing personalized treatments based on our treatment philosophy, including facials, chemical peels, facial massage, and more    Giving body and relaxation massage as part of our wellness treatments    Creating a safe, relaxing, and welcoming space for every client    Offering honest, thoughtful product recommendations    Supporting the daily rhythm at NAP, from prepping the room to creating beautiful client experiences﻿You are:    Trained, or training, in skincare, spa or massage therapy. Certified, newly graduated, or still studying, all three are welcome    Passionate about skin health and the power of human touch    Caring, positive, and naturally warm in your way of being    Someone who brings good energy into the room    Curious, grounded, and open to learning and growing with us    Already living in Sweden, with the legal right to work here    Able to get to our studio in Kungsholmen on the days we agree, since none of this work can be done remotelyIf you are still studying, this is a part-time place to get real hands on real skin while you finish.The role:    Part-time, hourly, on a schedule we agree in advance     Occasional weekend work is expected    English-speaking    Kungsholmen, Stockholm    Start date: FlexibleWorking at NAP means being part of something small, personal, and meaningful. We're not about rush or routines that feel robotic. We're here to make people feel seen, held, and truly taken care of.To apply:Everything happens here: https://join.napsthlm.comWe're looking for the right person, not the perfect CV. We'd love to know what draws you to this role, and what makes you feel at home in your work.We hope you understand that we will not be able to respond to everyone who reaches out by DM or email. The form is the only way for us to properly consider you, and there is no other way in.We usually receive hundreds of applications, so please take your time with it. We read every one of them ourselves, and we will do our best to come back to everyone who has thoughtfully filled it in, including the people we will not be taking further.We will start interviewing within the next 2 to 3 weeks. Either way, you will hear from us.

The Plant Coordinator supports the coordination and management of plant, vehicles, tools, and assets across operations in Sweden. The role supports asset management activities, lifecycle planning, and operational asset performance. The role supports plant availability, maintenance coordination, and efficient utilisation of company assets. The role works with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and service providers to support asset management, regulatory compliance, and commercial objectives.How this role lives our values This role supports the effective management of plant and assets by helping ensure that equipment, vehicles, and resources are available, maintained, and correctly managed throughout their lifecycle. By maintaining visibility of asset performance, availability, and compliance requirements, the role supports efficient operations and informed decision-making. Safety: Support a safe working environment by helping ensure assets, vehicles, equipment, and inspection requirements are managed in accordance with company and regulatory standards. Integrity: Support accuracy, accountability, and compliance through effective record management, asset tracking, and adherence to established processes. Teamwork: Build strong working relationships that support collaboration, communication, and coordinated asset management activities. Ownership: Take responsibility for following through on actions, resolving operational issues, and supporting the effective management of company assets. Sustainability: Support long-term value creation through responsible asset management, efficient utilisation, and sustainable lifecycle practices. Key ResponsibilitiesPlant & Asset Lifecycle Management:     Coordinate plant, vehicle, tool, and asset activities throughout the asset lifecycle, including receipt, return, allocation, and disposal in line with project requirements.     Support asset management strategies and asset replacement or upgrade planning. Maintenance & Compliance Coordination:     Coordinate planned and unplanned maintenance activities, inspections, testing requirements, and equipment compliance activities.     Maintain up-to-date asset records, tracking information, and compliance documentation, including leased and hired assets. Asset Operations & Procurement Support:     Coordinate plant movements, operational requirements, procurement activities, and supplier engagement.     Support commercial decision-making relating to plant acquisition, hire, utilisation, and cost management.     Support the procurement of fuel, spare parts, and other plant-related requirements. Sustainability & Asset Optimisation:     Support effective asset utilisation, reuse, sale, recycling, and sustainability initiatives in line with the company’s sustainability strategy. Fleet & Incident Coordination:     Coordinate fleet-related incidents, repairs, and recovery activities.    Coordinate vehicle maintenance requirements in line with applicable regional requirements. Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance:     Support compliance with safety, environmental, sustainability, regulatory, and internal company requirements. Commercial Administration:     Support the effective management of plant and asset-related costs.     Reconcile monthly invoices and account statements relating to plant and assets. Key Requirements     3rd level qualification or equivalent experience in procurement, purchasing, commercial functions, or construction plant operations.     Experience in a similar position (typically 3 years or more).     Knowledge of plant and asset management.     Knowledge of Swedish regulatory requirements and construction industry standards.     Experience using asset management systems and tools.     Analytical skills, process awareness, and attention to detail.     Communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.     Fluent English; Swedish language skills are advantageous.     Valid Swedish or EEA driver's licence.Skills     Plant and asset management knowledge.     Regulatory compliance knowledge.     Asset management systems knowledge.     Analytical and process management skills.     Stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.     Commercial awareness. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.Vänligen skicka in ditt CV och ansökan på engelska.

CRS Laboratories is looking for an **Operations Manager for Sweden** to oversee the operations of our Swedish site and manage projects and customer relationships in Sweden and Norway.Key responsibilities:- Managing the PhotonAssay installation project - Managing the day-to-day operations of CRS's Björkdal laboratory - Personnel management (approximately 6 employees) - Managing projects based in Sweden and Norway - Managing customer relationships and acquiring new customers Initially, the role will focus on delivering the PhotonAssay project, which is expected to take approximately six months. The other responsibilities can be arranged flexibly alongside this initial priority.We expect you to have:- A proven track record in project management - Experience in a supervisory role - Fluency in Swedish and English - Relevant industry experience or education (e.g. chemistry, geology) - Strong communication and networking skills This is a permanent, full-time position. The position is based at CRS's site in Kåge, Sweden. Flexible remote working arrangements are possible initially, but regular on-site presence will be required within a few months.For further information about the position, please contact our COO, Daniela Vesterbacka, at daniela.vesterbacka@crs.fi, +358 44 749 9711.

TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.Would you like to build digital products and services that connect vehicles, customers and the people who keep vehicles on the road?TECHLA is looking for experienced full-stack developers for assignments in automotive and connected services. You’ll work in product teams developing everything from customer-facing applications to cloud-based services and integrations.The technology stack varies by assignment. It may include React and TypeScript on the frontend, with backend services built using Java and Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, Python or Go. Teams work with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.What you’ll work onDepending on the assignment, you may:    Design, build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript    Develop backend services, APIs and integrations    Connect user-facing applications to cloud services and distributed systems    Work with microservices and event-driven architectures    Build and operate solutions on AWS or Azure    Develop automated tests and improve CI/CD, monitoring and service reliability    Contribute to technical design, code reviews and architecture discussions    Take features from requirements and design through implementation, testing and productionWhat we’re looking for    Several years of professional full-stack development experience, typically five or more    Hands-on experience developing both frontend and backend functionality    Strong frontend skills in React and TypeScript, or comparable modern web technologies    Strong backend experience in at least one relevant stack, such as Java/Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, Python or Go    Experience building APIs, integrations or distributed applications    Experience with AWS and/or Azure    A good understanding of testing, code quality and maintainable software    The ability to collaborate with colleagues across product, design and engineering    Fluent English; Swedish is a plus.    A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.It’s a plus if you have    GraphQL, Kafka or other event-streaming technologies    AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS    Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD    SQL and NoSQL databases    Experience from automotive, connected vehicles, telecom or other product-focused environments    Experience operating and improving production servicesThe mindset we’re looking forFor us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Open application - Logistic Support to World Leading Tech Company
jobs.description: This advert is published due to recurring requests for candidates within this role. It helps us build a pipeline so we can act quickly when we receive a new assignment.When we get a relevant request from a client, we will review applications from this ad and contact candidates whose profile matches the specific requirements. This also means you may not hear from us in between, as there may be no active assignment at the time.Demand for this role can change quickly, and during the summer period it may not always be active.Temp-Team Sweden AB is supporting one of the world’s leading and most recognized tech companies in recruiting Logistics/Warehouse Support staff for their Data Center in Gävle. If you are looking for a dynamic role in a high-performing environment, with opportunities to develop your skills within logistics, inventory management, and warehouse operations, this could be the right opportunity for you.You will play a vital part in making the Data Centers daily operations run smoothly. The team you will be joining covers the below responsibilities:Responsibilities:    Perform assigned Logistics/Warehouse Support tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations.    Seek guidance from management before proceeding with the next step of a process.    Perform data entry to document inbound and outbound packages.    Execute incoming and outgoing deliveries as instructed by management (e.g. purchase order (PO) receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor (RMS) activities).    Ensure accurate documentation of incoming and outgoing deliveries as well as records.    Perform cycle audits and data corrections to ensure all inventory controls are met.    Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.Requirements:    High School Diploma AND 6 months of experience or an internship in inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field.    Basic understanding of how to use Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word).    Physically in good health as the role requires a lot of walking and bending.    To be considered for this role, you must hold a Swedish passport or permanent residency (PR).We can offer you:    Attractive working conditions    Employment at one of the world’s most recognizes companies who over and over is celebrated as one of the world’s greatest places to work    Work schedule is full-time    Location: Gävle    Start date: Different start date depending on the request.     Temporary ResourceApplicationYou will be employed by Temp-Team Sweden AB, but working full-time at our client’s location.We connect skilled professionals with assignments at clients that are in the forefront of their field. If this sounds interesting, send a targeted CV (in English) and we will review it and get back to you if there's a match.It is very important that you communicate your experience within the above mentioned job details and requirements in your CV.For any questions regarding the position please contact Elnaz Memarian at elm@temp-team.se

Research shows that women and other under-represented groups within our industry hesitate to apply unless they tick most boxes of a role description. At Stegra, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core. We need a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team to rally behind our purpose of de-carbonizing hard-to-abate industries, starting with steel.So, if you are equally passionate about our purpose yet concerned that your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications stated in the job advert, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate, either for this role – or for another upcoming role in our rapidly growing business.About us:Stegra is on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. By using green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity instead of coal; water and heat will be our primary emissions. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. But this is just the beginning – our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize other industries in addition to steel, and we look forward to what’s next in store for us.We are looking for talented, innovative, and purpose-driven people to join our rapidly growing and diverse team. Our employees get to learn everyday, implement the latest technology and test and put their ideas into practice. Together, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core – for our people, customers, investors, society, and planet.Work location: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Project Engineer for our Project Delivery team. In this role you will work closely with our Groundworks Manager, Construction teams, EPCM Area Leads, planners, and contractors to support the delivery of civil and early works across the Boden project.As Project Engineer, you will help turn engineering packages into construction-ready scopes. You will coordinate documentation, interfaces, and execution requirements to ensure workfronts are properly prepared before being released to contractors. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working close to both engineering and site execution.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Coordinate preparation and release of groundworks scopes, ensuring drawings, quantities, and execution requirements are ready for construction    Maintain the Groundworks Scope Tracker and consolidate inputs from EPCM partners, design teams, and planners    Support forecasting and planning of upcoming groundworks activities    Coordinate scope clarifications between Engineering, Planning, Construction, and contractors    Support and maintain a structured RFI process between contractors and engineering stakeholders    Help align groundworks activities with project schedules, civil milestones, and interface dependencies    Participate in coordination meetings and support progress reporting and issue resolution    Monitor contractor readiness, access conditions, and documentation prior to site executionWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.This role is well suited to someone who has built a solid foundation in civil engineering or construction and wants to continue developing in a large-scale industrial project environment.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field    Around 3–7 years of experience from large-scale industrial, construction, or infrastructure projects    Good understanding of civil construction, design documentation, and site execution    Experience working in EPCM, contractor, or major project environments is considered an advantage    Strong coordination skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and disciplines    Familiarity with Primavera P6 or similar planning tools is considered an advantage    Experience with Swedish AMA/AB04 standards is considered a plus    Fluency in English; Swedish is considered an advantage

As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will play a central role in shaping the electrical and electronic architecture of our satellite platforms and ensuring the reliable performance of our missions. Our customers include major space companies, agencies, and commercial players across Europe and worldwide.OHB Sweden develops advanced small satellite systems for scientific and Earth observation missions. These missions require highly reliable avionics and electrical systems that form the backbone of the spacecraft, enabling power generation and distribution, communications, command and data handling, and mission operations.The Avionics & Electrical Department is responsible for the design, development, verification, and support of the satellite's electrical and electronic systems. The department currently consists of approximately 23 highly skilled engineers and specialists working in areas including:    Electrical Architecture    Electrical Power Systems (EPS)    TT&C and Communications Systems and RF Systems    EMC / EMI    Electronics Design    Radiation Engineering and EEE Component Usage    Data Handling Systems and Onboard Computers    Harness Design    FPGA Design    EGSE designThe department contributes throughout the complete spacecraft lifecycle, from early mission concepts and proposal activities, through design studies, detailed development, subsystem and system verification, launch preparation, and operational support.The space industry is evolving rapidly, driven by increased satellite autonomy, software-defined systems, miniaturized electronics, higher levels of integration, growing constellation markets, and increasing demands on cybersecurity, resilience, and manufacturability. At the same time, OHB Sweden is transitioning towards a higher degree of productization and industrialization of its satellite platforms. In this context, the Avionics & Electrical Department will play a key role in defining future platform architectures, technologies, methodologies, and engineering practices. As Head of Department, you will lead this evolution and ensure OHB Sweden remains a competitive and technically leading provider of advanced small satellite systems.As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will be mainly responsible for:    Driving staff recruitment, onboarding, and development to build a motivated and high-performing team.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Acting as a key point of contact for customers, partners, and suppliers on avionics, electrical, communications, electronics, and onboard computing matters.    Ensures that engineering processes relevant for the department activities exist and are properly implemented.    Ensures that proper engineering tools are efficiently used in the department    Owns the department ways-of-working.    Implementing strategic and operational decisions from the Company Management Team within the department.    Ensuring the department's skills and expertise align with the evolving needs of the company and its projects.    Reporting to employees and managers.    Overall responsibility for the technical deliveries from the department to the project in quality, time and cost.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Contributing to proposals by estimating costs and evaluating staffing.    Leading budgeting within your area of responsibility, covering general expenses, training, laboratories, equipment, and investments.What We're Looking For    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline.    At least 10 years of experience as an engineer and technical leader within avionics, electronics, electrical systems, communications, or a related field.    Proven leadership skills, with experience managing teams and coordinating complex, multidisciplinary engineering activities.    Strong understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical systems, including electrical architectures, power systems, communications, onboard computing, electronics development and testing.    Understanding of EMC, radiation effects, reliability, and engineering standards applicable to space systems.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to foster innovation and continuous improvement within the team.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is a plus.    A collaborative mindset, with experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.What We Offer    A unique opportunity to lead one of the key engineering departments responsible for the core avionics and electrical capabilities of our satellite platforms.    Involvement in all phases of satellite projects, from early studies and proposal work to launch and operations.    A supportive and innovative work environment, with opportunities for personal and professional growth.    Competitive salary and benefits, with flexibility for work-life balance.The Head of Avionics & Electrical Department will report to the Head of Engineering & Technology and play a key role in the company's technical leadership team. This position may require occasional travel, primarily within Europe.Join us and help shape the next generation of satellite avionics and electrical systems!

Company description:At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.Job description:Play a key role in a modern manufacturing environment At NKT, we are at the forefront of driving the green transition through advanced cable systems that power offshore and onshore energy infrastructure. Our complex high-voltage installations rely on advanced technology and meticulous execution—from production to rigorous testing—to deliver high-standard quality and reliability. In this very advanced and innovative production process in the cable industry, we continue to invest significantly in the latest technology.  As Director of production area 3, you will play a key role in optimizing production efficiency and strategic improvements by leading a team of leaders within a rotating five-shift production setup, consisting of approximately 200 employees. You will be responsible for one of three production areas and work closely with the other managers to ensure seamless collaboration and performance. Develop, motivate and lead our teamBy coordinating and managing plant equipment, personnel and production workflows, you will be responsible for delivering efficient and cost-effective production outcomes that meet order requirements, technical specifications, quality standards and planning targets. In addition, your responsibilities will be to:•    Prepare and oversee the annual production budget, taking strategic actions to stay within financial and resource limits.•    Oversee implementation of actions to improve production performance, while collaborating with continuous improvement teams to integrate Lean principles into production processes.•    Lead, motivate and develop team members to reach their full potential.•    Ensure compliance with HSE regulations and track progress.•    Align actions with customer expectations and needs Strategic leader who motivates people through changeYour ability to facilitate changes while maintaining motivation among team members highlights your solution-oriented leadership style. With a focus on service and a commitment to customer satisfaction, you take responsibility for your own actions as well as those of your production team. Furthermore, your communication skills together with a deep sense of understanding, helps you cultivate and uphold fruitful connections internally and externally. Additionally, your CV comprises:•    Secondary technical education. A university degree in Electrical Engineering or Manufacturing is meritorious.•    At least 3-5 years leadership experience managing around 100 people in a multishift production environment•    Change management experience with knowledge of Six Sigma or similar.•    Fluency in spoken and written Swedish and English•    A high level of self-motivation, curiosity and willingness to learn about new technologies. Empower sustainable growth through productionNKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are dedicated to establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.At NKT, you’ll be part of a collaborative team with respected values and a clear goal. We offer career development opportunities, international exposure, and the chance to grow your skills in a supportive environment. Join us in advancing the sustainable energy industry through innovative logistics. "Leading production area 3 means being part of our transformation journey, driving improvements and achieving results every day together with a strong team" says Hiring Manager, Louise Sjöberg Olausson. Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here! We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 22nd of November 2026. Be aware that background checks together with personality and cognitive tests will be included in the recruitment process.  Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.  Union representativesSveriges Ingenjörer - Christian Fisch, +46 455 56 380 Unionen – Joakim Wikström +46 734 070 243 Ledarna - Roger Jönsson, +46 455 55 911  Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.description: Job DescriptionThe Engineering Manager (EM) is accountable for technical execution, delivery quality, and operational excellence for a defined product or service. The role partners with Product Managers in product contexts and owns delivery and roadmap in service contexts. The EM combines delivery accountability with people leadership and has the mandate to make technical decisions aligned with strategy.    ABOUT THE TEAM The Pricing Foundation Team is a global product development team at H&M Group, driving the future of pricing across our brands and markets. We bring together product, business, engineering, quality assurance, analytics, and design expertise to build scalable solutions that enable accurate, automated, and data-driven pricing decisions. Working across Stockholm and Bangalore, we collaborate closely as one team to deliver business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers worldwide.  ABOUT THE SCOPE Our team owns the core pricing platform that powers H&M Group's global pricing operations. We are responsible for developing and evolving services that ensure consistent, scalable, and reliable pricing across brands, channels, and markets. By combining modern technology, automation, and strong business collaboration, we enable faster time to market, improved data quality, and seamless pricing experiences while supporting H&M's digital transformation journey. We're on an ambitious transformation journey, redefining how pricing works across H&M Group. For our team members, this means the opportunity to work with modern technologies, solve complex business challenges at scale, and grow alongside a product area that is shaping the future of global retail pricing.  WHO YOU ARE      Deep expertise in engineering (end-to-end development process understanding)       Deep expertise in architecture, scalable design principles and cloud fundamentals      Familiarity with automated build, test, and deployment pipelines – CI/CD & DevOps     Ability to assess and manage technical debt.       Hands-on capability to stay up to date with the technology being led       Coaching and leadership skills.       Strong communication and stakeholder management.       Experience in vendor collaboration and external partnerships.       Financial acumen – ability to manage tech budgets.       Strong understanding of agile ways of working, including continuous improvement practices.       Ability to balance technical trade-offs with business priorities.       Analytical thinking: leveraging data and insights to inform decisions.       Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity.       Strong security & compliance skills, securing coding and regulatory awareness       Understanding of monitoring, incident management and SRE practices     And who has..      Strong in engineering and architecture expertise      Ability to manage technical debt      Strong stakeholder communication skills      Vendor collaboration experience      Financial/budget awareness      Strong agile ways of working      Security and compliance understanding      Monitoring and incident management knowledge  WHO WE ARE  H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.      Staff discount card: Usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.      H&M Incentive Program (HIP): Included in our HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.      Competitive pensions: Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to the Swedish market.      Generous vacation: 30 days' vacation, health care allowance, and good work-life balance.      Additional perks: Discounts from Benify.      Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.      Global Impact: Be part of a team that influences users worldwide.      Professional Growth: Endless opportunities to learn and develop your skills.      Collaborative Culture: Join a motivated team that values collaboration and excellence.   JOIN US  Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  This is a full-time permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to the agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.  Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through the career page.  Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!  *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.  Please apply 21 September 2026.

RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.Do you have experience in software test management and want to improve cancer care for patients around the world? Join RaySearch's development department as Verification and Validation Manager for RayCare! About the position RayCare is an innovative oncology information system designed to support clinical workflows at cancer clinics. It is developed by multiple agile teams working closely together, with expertise spanning clinical workflows, integrations, and system architecture. We develop our products in close collaboration with leading cancer clinics worldwide. As Verification and Validation Manager for RayCare, you will be part of the RaySearch Product Safety team and play a central role in ensuring product quality throughout the development lifecycle. Together with the team, you will plan, lead, and document development projects, ensuring that we deliver safe and high-quality software to our users. In this role, you will work closely with development teams, product management, and other stakeholders across the organization. The work is dynamic and cross-functional, requiring both structure and adaptability. Your main tasks     Develop, own, and continuously evolve the Verification and Validation strategy for RayCare releases.    Lead the associated V&V activities in accordance with RaySearch development and risk management processes, using a risk-based and lifecycle-oriented approach that supports product quality and regulatory compliance.     Ensure fit-for-purpose test environments, test tools, and ways of working that enable teams to implement the Verification and Validation strategy effectively.      Drive continuous improvement of V&V execution, with a particular focus on increased automation.     Create compliant V&V documentation, including test specifications, reports, and V&V summaries. Your profile We believe that you have a background as a verification and validation manager or a similar leading role within software testing. You are pragmatic in your approach and able to structure and prioritize work in a dynamic environment. You enjoy solving problems as they arise and take initiative to improve ways of working— - especially when it comes to automation and efficiency. You are comfortable coordinating across with teams and stakeholders and have strong communication skills. Requirements     BSc or MSc degree in engineering, or equivalent     5+ years of experience in verification and validation management within software development     Excellent written and spoken communication skills (English and Swedish) Meriting     Strong experience driving test automation and working with system integrations in complex environments    Experience coordinating validation usability testing and working within agile development methodologies    Background in the MedTech industry, with hands-on experience applying AI-driven and agentic testing approaches Our CultureCulture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.Our OfferAt RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.ApplicationPlease apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

The Impact You'll Make You play a key role in keeping critical service operations running smoothly across Scandinavia. In this position, you combine technical understanding with strong coordination skills to support customers, service engineers, and partners working with Danfoss frequency converters and drive solutions.By coordinating complex service cases end to end, you help ensure customers in Denmark, Norway, and Sweden receive reliable, timely support when it matters most. Your technical background enables you to understand customer challenges, assess service requirements, and communicate effectively with both customers and field service engineers. Through your daily decisions and continuous improvement mindset, you help strengthen Danfoss' service experience and long-term customer trust across the region.  This position can be based at our offices in Linköping or Stockholm, or you can from a home office in the Malmö or Gothenburg area.What You’ll Be Doing    Coordinate end-to-end service cases across Scandinavia, from request creation to successful closure, ensuring smooth execution and clear ownership    Act as the primary customer contact, gathering technical information, clarifying service requirements, and ensuring engineers are equipped with the right information before site visits    Schedule and dispatch field resources and partners, making daily prioritization decisions based on customer impact and technical complexity    Follow up on execution and documentation, ensuring service work is completed on time and closed with high-quality, accurate information    Identify and drive operational improvements that reduce delays, improve collaboration, and enhance the customer experienceWhat We're Looking For    Technical background within electrical engineering, automation, electronics, or a related field    Experience in service coordination, service operations, commissioning engineer or technical customer service in an industrial or field service environment    Solid organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple service cases and changing priorities    Clear and confident communication skills with customers, technicians, partners, and internal stakeholders    Fluency in Swedish and English; additional Scandinavian languages are considered an advantage What You'll Get from UsAt Danfoss, you’ll join a collaborative and international service organization where your contribution is visible and valued. We offer a role with real operational influence, close collaboration across countries, and opportunities to grow your coordination and leadership capabilities. You’ll work in a culture built on trust, inclusion, and continuous improvement, supported by knowledgeable colleagues and a strong purpose: driving sustainable solutions and reliable service for our customers across the region.Ready to Make a Difference?If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Silex Microsystems is the world’s leading pure-play MEMS foundry, customizing solutions for prominent global clients in industries such as pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, and automotive. As a Process Engineer, you will initiate and drive progress in the Plasma Deposition area. Sounds interesting? Keep reading.Would you like to know more about Silex and what we do?The AreaThe Plasma deposition area is one of several vital departments of our production line here at Silex. Several different deposition techniques (PVD, PECVD, ALD and evaporation) are utilized to deposit thin films, ranging from various metals to dielectrics.You will work with both engineers, process operators and service technicians where collaboration is critical to ensure good process stability, tool uptime and continuous improvement.The roleYour overall responsibility is to ensure manufacturing goals are met, together with operators and service technicians. Your days will be a mix of meetings with Product Managers, developing new processes that meet customers' specifications and ensure reliable production processes.You will also participate in creating work routines for operators and solve problems that occur at the area, driving improvement projects to enhance our workflow and processes at the Plasma Deposition area.In this role, you will:    Develop, maintain and improve thin film deposition processes.    Establish, and maintain routines and documentation.    Handle stopped production batches and development material together with process integration engineers (PIs).    Be a part of creating and improving the infrastructure for operator training to make sure current routine is available and up to date.    Participate in process qualification of new equipment or materials and release them to production.    Participate in the startup of new products, review specifications and process flows.    Grow into taking responsibility for area equipment, improving the tool uptime, maintain and develop new standardized process modules.We are looking for someone who has:    A PhD degree in relevant field, or a Master’s degree combined with a couple of years of relevant industrial experience. Specializing in Nanotechnology, Microfabrication, Applied Physics or Material Science is considered as highly beneficial.    An understanding of plasma physics or semiconductor processing principles. Hands-on experience with deposition equipment, e.g. PVD, PECVD, ALD and evaporation is considered a merit.    The ability to see opportunities for improvement and manage projects to follow through with those improvements.    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.    Strong skills in documentation and quality management    Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in Swedish is considered a merit.What we offer you    An opportunity to work closely with talented and inspiring colleagues in a collaborative environment.    A chance to be part of a world-leading company, driving the future of MEMS technology.    The ability to engage with cutting-edge innovations that shape global industries and everyday life.    The satisfaction of contributing directly to transformative technologies at the industry’s most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry.About Silex Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS technology is moving into an abundance of modern innovations; from data centers, consumer and automotive electronics to medical diagnostics and life science.The recruitment process We have an ongoing recruitment process, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few brief questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test, reference checks, and a background check. Additionally, a drug test will be conducted prior to employment, and we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

At Embark, we are exploring what it means to build living games by choosing the smartest route while striving towards a healthy work-life balance. As a Senior Producer on ARC Raiders, you will join the game’s core leadership team, working in close partnership with the Executive Producer, production leads, and discipline leads to safeguard the quality, player sentiment, and ongoing product direction of our live game.We see game development, especially in a live environment, as a constant work in progress and a living journey. In this role, you will be a product-minded leader with a strong appetite for community engagement and external communication. While our Production Director owns studio planning, P&L, and staffing, you will focus on the "What" and "Why" and the player impact. In close collaboration with the directors, you will help assess what is best for our players, deeply understanding why we make specific choices. You will focus on product health, drive update quality, and ensure that player feedback directly informs our live strategy. You will manage expectations upward, delegate with trust, and champion creative ideas that don't just meet expectations, but actively surprise and delight our community.Examples of Responsibilities    Product Ownership & Alignment: Sit on the ARC Raiders leadership team, collaborating with the EP, production leads, and discipline leads to drive product strategy and translate vision into high-quality live updates.    Game Quality & Sentiment Ownership: Serve as the guardian for update quality, player sentiment, and product health to ensure every release, feature, and patch lands with high polish and positive player response.    Community Connection & External Communication: Partner closely with the Community Team to listen to player feedback, translate insights into actionable game updates, and help shape clear, empathetic communication directly with our community.    Living Product Mindset: Embrace the reality that a live game is under constant evolution, guiding the game's direction through iteration, community sentiment, and data-informed decision-making.    Expectation Management & Delegation: Manage product expectations upward to executive stakeholders and internally across the studio, knowing when to step in, when to delegate, and how to empower cross-functional teams.    Collaborative Problem-Solving & Delight: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional feature teams to solve complex creative and product challenges while fostering an environment where teams are empowered to take creative risks that delight players.We would love if you have    8+ years of experience in AAA PC or console games production, including experience as a Product Owner, Senior Lead Producer, or Game Lead on a major live-service (GaaS) title.    Proven track record of owning product strategy and live quality, with a strong emphasis on player retention, community sentiment, and post-launch engagement.    Deep curiosity and understanding of game design, player motivations, understanding feedback and data, product rationale, and being able to grasp and articulate why specific choices are made for the game and community.    A strong appetite for external communication and community dynamics and are comfortable acting as a bridge between internal game development and the player base.    A mindset that views games as living software and are comfortable navigating constant change and viewing live game development as an ongoing journey.    Strong leadership presence & capability to build high-trust partnerships with production and discipline leads.    Exceptional communication skills with a focus on collaboration, empathetic player engagement, and strong collaboration & delegation habits.    Deep passion for PC/console games, competitive/co-op multiplayer ecosystems, and community dynamics. This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!
